Rafael — I reviewed the attachments and drafted tracked changes on the MSA (Redlines_MSA_v2_trackchanges.docx). Summary of legal position and open items: 

1) Term / Price Alignment — we can accept 18 months. We'll add a single mutual review at month 12 with a requirement that any price changes are negotiated in good faith and cannot be retroactive. That should be acceptable to Clearwave.

2) Ramp credits — we won't commit to an uncapped percentage credit for multiple months. Proposed language: credits apply if average sustained throughput over a month is below the scheduled minimum in Exhibit B; credit equals the pro rata difference multiplied by a credit rate (up to 25% of that invoice line) and limited to the first 90 days following the effective date. This preserves predictability.

3) SLA credit cap — counsel recommends a per-incident cap (5% of monthly invoice) and annual aggregate cap (20% of annualized subscription fees). We note client asked for per-incident cap only; add a customer-friendly example in the comments to illustrate impact.

4) Indemnity / Data residency — no material changes requested, but we should ensure Exhibit B has the correct region tags for their nodes. 

5) Approval path — I'm attaching the redlines. Please confirm the commercial team's preferred credit cap and whether ops can commit to reserved burst headroom for the first 90 days; if ops can't, we should tighten the credit to 60 days.
